text:
Maria (eng-platform): @channel FinMerch is seeing a spike of 503s on their dedicated pool since the runtime bump at 09:12 UTC. Customer flagged SLA risk. Can owners confirm root cause and a mitigation timeline?

Kevin (eng-sre): saw the alert, investigating logs now. p99 tail looks like RPC timeouts to pool-3 nodes. Could be kernel-level OOM kills after the new kernel modules. :eyes:

Anita (eng-runtime): I pulled a few logs from the runtime side — KV cache misses spiking, lots of backpressure. Not seeing OOMs in kube events yet. We did change a batching heuristic in the bump.

Sam (eng-releases): Canary rollout progressed to 60% at 09:10. If it's the batching change, we can pause/rollback canary to 0% immediately. PR ref: #3487.

Kevin (eng-sre): Agree rollback canary now, will remove nodes from LB and flip traffic. ETA 8–10m. I'll also fire a temporary routing override to route FinMerch to the previous variant.

Michael (eng-platform): I can own the rollback and the follow-up patch. Plan: 1) rollback canary -> stop spikes (10m), 2) patch batching logic to add safety guard (PR by EOD), 3) small canary with extra telemetry (overnight). Assigning owners: rollback & patch reviews: @michael and @anita.

Anita (eng-runtime): Assigned. I'll push a hotfix branch and open a PR for the safety guard. Will include a metric for KV miss rate and backpressure counter.

Devon (customer-success): Let me know exact ETA so I can tell FinMerch. They want a workaround timeline and whether there's a temporary SLA credit plan.

Kevin (eng-sre): Rollback started at 09:22 UTC. Routing override applied for FinMerch at 09:25. Monitoring now.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-8421 created (severity: p1) — oncall: @kevin.

Maria (eng-platform): Can someone ping code review owners? We need the hotfix merged before we re-roll the canary. @sam can you expedite the merge queue?

Sam (eng-releases): I'll prioritize PR #3492 (hotfix) and move it to the top of the release queue. Please add the release notes line and a test case for the batching guard.

Michael (eng-platform): Quicknote for dependency tracking: this touches serving runtime and routing. Need eng-sre signoff on routing override and eng-runtime signoff on patch. I'll add a short checklist in the PR.

Anita (eng-runtime): Hotfix PR opened: #3492. Patch changes: add max-batch-size fallback and disable auto-aggressive-batching when backpressure>0. Test added.

Kevin (eng-sre): FinMerch 503 rate dropped to baseline after override. Will keep monitoring for 30m and then decide on canary re-roll.

Devon (customer-success): I told the customer rollback is in progress and we expect external impact mitigated within 15m. They're asking about a postmortem and a formal SLA mitigation. I'll coordinate with legal for credit language.

Maria (eng-platform): Good. Can everyone add ETA labels on the PR and add owners in the checklist? Also add any fallout tickets (support/ops/customer) to link here.

Michael (eng-platform): I put the checklist in PR and created ENG-6034 to track follow-ups (postmortem, SLA communication, monitoring alerts).

Anita (eng-runtime): Requesting a quick CR ping: @lina and @joel, could you review #3492? Small, focused change.

Sam (eng-releases): Merged #3492 at 09:46 UTC after expedited review and CI pass. Tagging release v2025.3.1-hotfix.

Kevin (eng-sre): Monitoring looks stable. FinMerch 503s at baseline for 20m. Closing immediate incident but keeping INC-8421 open for postmortem until ENG-6034 is done.

Devon (customer-success): Customer updated, they appreciate the quick rollback and want a postmortem + timeline for preventive changes.

Maria (eng-platform): Thanks all — owners: rollback & monitoring @kevin, hotfix & follow-ups @michael & @anita, release queue @sam, CS comms @devon. We'll sync async on ENG-6034. :thumbsup:

Kevin (eng-sre): Confirmed. If anything flares up I'll reopen.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-8421 status changed to "resolved (monitoring)" at 10:12 UTC.
